blocks.text: NAIROBI, Kenya — A self-proclaimed Kenyan preacher was found guilty Friday of the manslaughter of 123 people, barely a month after being sentenced to 200 years in prison for the murders of children in an infamous starvation cult. Hundreds of bodies have been discovered since 2023 at the sect’s base near the coastal resort of Malindi in what became known as the “Shakahola Forest Massacre.” Paul Mackenzie has faced multiple charges linked to the cult in different courts, but this is the final conviction in a series of cases that have lasted years.
